Everyone helps his neighbor. They say to their brothers, “Be strong!”

Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They…
They bear it on their shoulder. They carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its…
He received what they handed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they said…
They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have…
For the customs of the peoples are vanity; for one cuts a tree out of the forest, the work of the hands of the workman…
Behold, isn’t it of Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?

translations.web: The blacksmith takes an ax, works in the coals, fashions it with hammers, and works it with his strong arm. He is hungry, and his strength fails; he drinks no water, and is faint.
translations.bsb: The blacksmith takes a tool and labors over the coals; he fashions an idol with hammers and forges it with his strong arms. Yet he grows hungry and loses his strength; he fails to drink water and grows faint.
translations.kjv: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
translations.asv: The smith maketh an axe, and worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with his strong arm: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth; he drinketh no water, and is faint.
